name: Hyper Shining Heroes
source:
Youe Rex, an 18 year old young man in his last year of high school, your normal life changes drastically when you are chosen as one of the Hyper Shining Heroes, a group of heroes whose mission is to protect the world from evil forces. 

Strengthen your friendship with your co-workers and fight together against evil... Well... Maybe hanging out with several hot guys in less than discreet clothes will spark a certain romance.

[From Itch.io]
